s1.syndrome_frame: Acute abdominal syndrome with pancreatic involvement and worsening glycemic control in a patient with a history of diabetes and cardiovascular disease
salient_findings: Swelling of the pancreas with a peripheral rim on imaging
key_facts: 67-year-old man with a 3-year history of type 2 diabetes mellitus
Managed with metformin and glimepiride
Prior percutaneous coronary intervention for acute myocardial infarction 2 months earlier
40-year smoking history, quit after myocardial infarction
Four episodes of bloody diarrhea daily
No abdominal pain or fever
Normal white-cell count, bilirubin, and liver function tests
Plasma glucose rose from 258 mg/dL to 449 mg/dL
Hemoglobin A1c increased from 7.3% to 8.0%
Microalbuminuria of 50.7 mg/day
Anti–glutamic acid decarboxylase antibodies were negative
Elevated serum amylase and lipase
Swelling of the pancreas with a peripheral rim on contrast-enhanced CT and MR cholangiopancreatography

shortlist.label: Autoimmune pancreatitis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated serum IgG4 and pancreatic swelling with a peripheral rim on imaging

shortlist.label: IgG4-related pancreatitis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated serum IgG4 and pancreatic involvement

shortlist.label: Chronic pancreatitis
shortlist.why_kept: History of smoking and abdominal symptoms

shortlist.label: Ulcerative colitis-associated pancreatitis
shortlist.why_kept: Diagnosis of ulcerative colitis and pancreatic involvement

shortlist.label: Pancreatic cancer
shortlist.why_kept: History of smoking and pancreatic swelling on imaging

raw.rationale: Elevated serum IgG4, swelling of the pancreas with a peripheral rim, and elevated serum amylase and lipase are consistent with IgG4-related pancreatitis

rejected.label: Autoimmune pancreatitis
rejected.why: While similar, the presence of other systemic symptoms or elevated IgG4 levels specifically points towards IgG4-related disease

rejected.label: Chronic pancreatitis
rejected.why: Lack of long-term pancreatic damage history and absence of typical risk factors like alcohol abuse

rejected.label: Ulcerative colitis-associated pancreatitis
rejected.why: No clear evidence linking ulcerative colitis to pancreatitis in this case, and other findings better explained by IgG4-related disease

rejected.label: Pancreatic cancer
rejected.why: Imaging findings and lab results do not specifically indicate malignancy, and the clinical presentation is more suggestive of an inflammatory process
